bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to unemployment insurance; providing an emergency medical services work exception in certain circumstances.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES WORK EXCEPTION.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 268.085, or any other law to the contrary, for an applicant who was laid off from an employer in the iron ore mining industry on or after April 1, 2025, and before July 2, 2025:

(1) working temporarily in the labor market area emergency medical services sector is considered good cause for failing to apply for, accept, or avoid suitable employment; and

(2) no deduction shall be made from the applicant's weekly unemployment benefit amount for earnings from temporary employment in the labor market area emergency medical services sector.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively from April 1, 2025.

(2) no deduction shall be made from the applicant's weekly unemployment benefit amount for earnings from temporary employment in the labor market area emergency medical services sector.
This section is effective retroactively from April 1, 2025.
